description: Version history: one row per generated documentation version per application.

columns.name: Title
columns.notes: e.g. 'Invoice Approval v1.1' — computed by the worker for readability.

columns.name: Version
columns.notes: e.g. '1.1' — see worker/versioning/version.py for the numbering policy.

columns.name: SnapshotPath
columns.notes: Path/URL to snapshot.json in the document library.

columns.name: CreatedBy
columns.notes: The user who requested the job that produced this version, not necessarily the SharePoint item author.
